attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his Substack post, published 2024-12-21, in his own voice.

semantics.note: Keeps the 'from what I can recall' hedge and frames the claim as his own report of what he saw in the demo, not as a statement about everything the demo contained.

contract.note: Reading the claim as a hedged personal report fits his words. The other reading, that the demo itself held no such evidence, would change the claim. Under the autobiographical reading, no outside source can check it.

reviews.rationale: This is a hedged, autobiographical account of what Marcus recalls seeing. A demo recording could show what OpenAI presented, but not what he perceived or remembers. The evidence packet is empty and explains why. There is nothing testable to score.
